text:
yara: heads-up I opened a tiny PR to clarify the "call contract" guidance for function/tool outputs and add two compact examples + a short SDK helper. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5145

ton y: nice. can you show both a bare-call minimal example and a compact contract envelope that carries metadata (we want a short canonical way to show provenance)? keep examples very short.

priya: also add a one-line normalizer for nullable lists. we've been getting support tickets where tools return null or a single object and consumers explode.

sam: for the SDK helper, keep it <=7 lines and make the thrown error message deterministic so examples-tests can assert on it. exact string please.

yara: draft bare call example in the PR:
```json
{"name":"check_balance","arguments":{"account":"acct_7"}}
```

and the compact contract envelope we're proposing (recommended when adding metadata):
```json
{"request":{"name":"check_balance","arguments":{"account":"acct_7"}},"ctx":{"src":"ledger","ver":"1.2"}}
```

priya: I like the shorter keys (`request` + `ctx`) — less noisy. add a one-line note: prefer compact key names for envelopes to reduce token overhead.

ton y: tiny guardrail: recommend tolerating extra fields for forward-compatibility. show a schema fragment with "additionalProperties": true. explain briefly why: future fields shouldn't break clients.

eng-runtime: runtime note: current engine attaches schema under "structured_output_schema"; we're planning a rename to "structured_schema" in a future release. docs should reference the current key and link runtime#782 for the migration.

priya: nullable-list shim suggestion (1 line):
```js
const normalized = Array.isArray(res.items) ? res.items : (res.items ? [res.items] : []);
```
this converts null -> [] and single-object -> [obj]. super handy.

sam: SDK helper draft (6 lines) — shows parse + deterministic error string for tests:
```js
try {
  const parsed = parseStructured(resp, schema);
  return parsed;
} catch (e) {
  throw new Error("ContractParseError: missing required field 'account'");
}
```

yara: added that to the PR and linked the runtime issue for the schema-key rename. also added a one-sentence guardrail paragraph: "Prefer tolerating extra fields (additionalProperties: true) to allow forward-compatible schema evolution."

ci-bot: CI queued for PR #5145 — lint: running, md-link-check: running, examples-tests: queued.

ci-bot: examples-tests: failed (1 assertion): expected error text mismatch in the SDK helper negative path.

priya: the failure is because some test harnesses strip single quotes. easiest fix: keep the thrown string exactly as our tests expect and add a unit test asserting it. not worth trying to detect runtime formatting.

sam: updated the helper to ensure the thrown string uses single quotes and added a tiny example-test that asserts on `ContractParseError: missing required field 'account'`. pushed.

ci-bot: rerun CI for PR #5145 — lint: pass, md-link-check: pass, examples-tests: pass.

ton y: quick editorial pass done. tiny grammar nits. LGTM from me.

priya: added a short sentence recommending `ctx.confidence` only when the model provides calibrated scores.

ci-bot: PR #5145 merged by yara — docs site will rebuild in the next deploy window. :shipit:

yara: thanks everyone. small change but should reduce a lot of confusion on the support side.

sam: can we add a follow-up issue to catalog common nullable-array culprits (tool endpoints that return single object) so we can add targeted examples later? I'll open one.

yara: please do. tagging for follow-up: docs backlog.
